Hello. I love your art. If possible, I would like to request.

A: https://imgur.com/a/u4RG9B5
B: https://imgur.com/a/eINEmjX
Info (height, personality) is attached.

They are coworkers and partners at a detective firm. Parker is Jinwoo's superior. After realizing Parker's loneliness, Jinwoo starts to follow Parker and document his experiences. As Parker starts to open up, they form a friendship.
They bicker often. Jinwoo teases Parker, while Parker goes out of his way to irritate Jinwoo. For example, they can never agree on what to listen to on the car radio, and end up shouting at each other until Parker threatens to crash the car. Jinwoo often grabs Parker or covers Parker's mouth to shut him up, only to feel awkward when Parker is so submissive in response. Despite how much they argue, Jinwoo promised himself to never be another person who makes Parker sad. They are attracted to each other.

Please draw them however you like. Thank you for your consideration.
